Project capable of powering 300,000 homes, with Britain having offered more than £770m to rebuild energy sector

Britain will add to its multimillion pound investments in rebuilding Ukraine’s energy system by funding a windfarm project capable of powering 300,000 Ukrainian households.

Ed Miliband, the UK foreign secretary, said Britain would invest £9.5m to build a 200 megawatt windfarm in an undisclosed location to bolster Ukraine’s energy reserves as its war with Russia approaches the five-year mark.
